transcript.text: hotpoint SA2 oven not heatin on fan, grill ok. wat does SA2 mean??

SA2 is simply Hotpoint’s internal code for your specific oven-cooker model. Since the grill works but the fan oven doesn’t heat, it often points to settings or the fan-oven element itself rather than a total power failure. First, please ensure the clock isn’t flashing and that you have switched from any automatic timer mode to manual operation, as this can block heating after a power cut. Also double-check that the function dial is clearly on the fan symbol (fan with a ring) and not on defrost or light-only modes. If it’s set correctly but still no heat, try setting it to 180°C for fifteen minutes to see if the element begins to warm up.
clock is fine n its in manual. dial is on the fan symbol. fan at back isnt spinning tho, just a low hum. grill works fine

The low hum and fan not spinning suggests the fan motor might be seized or failing, which would also stop the heating element from working since it needs airflow. Please switch off the cooker at the wall for safety before you check anything inside. Once it’s cool, look behind the rear panel to see if the fan blade is loose or blocked by debris. If the blade spins freely by hand, the motor itself is likely faulty and needs replacing.
ok isolated it at the cooker switch. fan blade is very stiff by hand, feels gritty. also had a slight hot smell from the back once, not now

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. The gritty stiffness and hot smell suggest the fan motor bearings are failing, which can cause overheating and damage nearby wiring or elements. Because of this burning hazard, you should not use the oven until a qualified engineer has checked it. However, given the smell and stiffness, an engineer visit is strongly recommended to prevent further damage.
